title: Scalar closure and normalized comparison limit image
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, composable scheme morphisms $Z\xrightarrow{h}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$ with $\ell$ invertible at every point, three constructible derived-complete integral objects $M_i$ on $Y$, arbitrary flat-term K-flat representatives $P_i$, and isomorphisms $Q(P_i)\cong M_i$. Use the exact quotient complexes, finite expressions, substitutions and transports of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data]. Fix also $\iota:E\to L$. For any GoodExpressions and invertibility proofs for the E substitutions, every ScalarGenerated expression is ScalarGood, and ScalarLimitImage holds: there are normalized L Roos/scalar models and invertible recursive L substitutions; the two actual strict scalar routes are equal; their limit image is the prescribed canonical L comparison; and each route yields both specified completed scalar/pullback/tensor composites. The canonical integral comparison used here is the coherent-counit construction of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-integral-construction]; scalar compatibility of that comparison is not assumed.

proof.text: Induct on ScalarGenerated. Quotient-goodness and representative normalization handle E inputs. Tensor reconstruction, transported pullback normalization, normalized units and scalar-goodness handle all constructors. Use normalized counit isomorphisms to transfer normalization through each operation; levelwiseFlatModels supplies the levelwise assertion.

proof.text: Choose normalized L Roos models at X and Y and normalized scalar models from the existing existence lemmas. The closure induction gives goodL for every strict expression on scalar quotients. The scalar leaf substitution is an isomorphism since reduction of the E substitution and the K-flat scalar counit are isomorphisms. Induct on expressions using substitute_inputs_iso to obtain invertibleL.

proof.text: Apply the two new strictly smaller uncancelled coordinate lemmas. Postcompose each equation with the inverse L target substitution. Cancel its forward factor using hom_inv_id; the beta comparison becomes the canonical L transport. Equality of the strict routes gives both equations for either route. Assemble these equations with the chosen models, goodL, invertibleL and generated closure into ScalarLimitImage.

lean.statement:
theorem completedComparisonScalarLimitImage
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M : Fin 3 → sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : Fin 3 → (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i).obj ≅ (M i).obj)
    (good : GoodExpressions l E h f P)
    (invertible : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      IsIso (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good A)) :
    (∀ (d : Bool) (W : Scheme.{u}) (A : ScalarComplex l E L d W),
      ScalarGenerated l E L ι h f (fun i ↦ quotient l E (P i).obj) d W A →
        ScalarGood l E L d W A) ∧
    ScalarLimitImage l E L ι h f M P φ good invertible
